designer.notes: Overall design execution is visually impressive and establishes a strong, professional cyberpunk command-center aesthetic for PROFESSOR XMD. Typography with GeistSans, live system gauges, Swahili cultural greetings, and custom agent illustrations give the product a bespoke agency-grade feel. However, M1 cannot pass without resolving the 3 defects: missing mobile bottom navigation on /board, low contrast on bottom nav inactive items (2.92 vs 4.5), and touch targets under 44px.

frontend.notes: No horizontal overflow detected at any viewport (scrollWidth matches clientWidth at 375, 768, and 1280). No console or harness errors observed. GeistSans font loaded smoothly. Primary remediation needed for M1 sign-off is: (1) ensuring the mobile bottom nav bar renders globally including on /board, (2) adjusting button/link min-heights to ≥44px, and (3) brightening inactive bottom nav labels to meet 4.5:1 contrast.

ledger.decision_summary: Header on top; conversation/board in the main area; on mobile a bottom navigation bar. Every interactive control ≥44×44 px. Text contrast ≥4.5:1 (WCAG AA). No horizontal overflow at 375/768/1280.
Calm, professional, dense-but-readable UI; one consistent type scale; icons with accessible labels.
